summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares itself a React UI extension but its `preinstall` hook runs `setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from oven-sh/bun GitHub releases, unzips it, marks it executable, and then invokes a sibling file `math_init.js` under that freshly downloaded runtime via `execFileSync`. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB heavily obfuscated bundle (obfuscator.io-style string-array + rotator, `_0x`-mangled identifiers, `// @bun @bun-cjs` header) with no corresponding source in the tarball and no relationship to the library's `dist/index.js`. Fetching a second language runtime specifically to execute an opaque obfuscated blob at npm install time is an alternate-runtime dropper pattern: the payload runs automatically on `npm install`, evades Node-based static scanners because it only executes under Bun, and its actual behavior is intentionally hidden. The mechanism (auto-executed, obfuscated, purpose-mismatched code running at install time) constitutes arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
